summary: REQ-1 appears implemented by updating FACEBOOK_URL to a real Facebook page URL. REQ-2 appears implemented by adding external-URL validation and rendering social icons as either real external anchors (with target/rel) or non-interactive disabled elements when URLs are placeholders. The diff also introduces unrequested behavior (UTM-tracked caffeine.ai link and LinkedIn hardening) beyond the stated requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a UTM-tracked caffeine.ai attribution link with dynamic hostname-based utm_content in the footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in REQ-1/REQ-2, and it introduces tracking parameters (even if not for social links).
evidence: frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx ("Generate UTM-tracked caffeine.ai link" and `caffeineLink = https://caffeine.ai/?utm_source=...`)

hallucinated_features.description: Extended the placeholder/disabled-link hardening logic to LinkedIn (validation + disabled rendering) in the footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 explicitly calls out applying the behavior consistently to Facebook and X/Twitter; it does not request changing LinkedIn behavior.
evidence: frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx (adds `isLinkedInValid` and conditional render for LinkedIn link vs disabled div)
